claims.text: Many reviewers find the applicator easy to use for applying oils and other products to hair and scalp, with the comb teeth helping to dispense product mess-free.
Several reviewers report that the bottle leaks, especially with thin liquids like oil, both during and after use.
Some reviewers note the comb teeth are too wide or the holes dispense too freely for runny liquids, making it better suited for thicker substances.
A few reviewers mention durability or stability issues, including a bottle bursting apart and the container tipping over easily.
Reviewers appreciate that it works well for specific uses like henna, flea powder, scalp oiling, and protective styles without tangling in hair.
